note: Multi-rater distribution learning on LIDC is a decade-deep literature (Prob U-Net, PHiSeg, SSN, annotator-sampling); the calibration-vs-Dice tradeoff has been quantified repeatedly. Lit-attacked below.

Information-preservation argument is the sharp part (perturbations a radiologist provably tolerates); learnable-windowing papers exist but the fragility audit itself may be open. Needs radiologist-validated ranges.
Fully subsumed by W2-A-0062's dimensionless crossover law; keeping both dilutes the same experiment.

Pathological-size failure is exactly the clinically dangerous case benchmarks average away; MedSAM box-perturbation studies exist, so the size-percentile stratification must carry the paper. Matched-difficulty control is mandatory.
Tissue-characterization literature has long treated speckle as signal; the segmentation-specific 2x2 ablation is a modest but real gap. Filter-dependence risk is handled by the 3-filter design.
Tellez et al. (Med Image Anal 2019) ran essentially this factorial: augmentation dominates normalization cross-site. The per-class sign-flip residual is not enough to resurrect it.

Supervision-modality-matching hypothesis is the interesting core; Dice-per-dollar methodology is fragile (NLP extraction quality is a moving target, own note). MICCAI-viable if costs are instrumented honestly.
Directional uncertainty vs isotropic models, anchored to radiotherapy margins, is a genuinely new axis; data scarcity (multi-rater glioma + orientation fields) is the tax. Protect as HRHR.
Longitudinal SSL is plausible and ADNI/OASIS are public, but matched-compute pretraining duels are expensive and the registration-shortcut risk needs careful objective design.

Partial-label negative transfer is a known problem with known fixes (marginal/exclusion losses, universal models); the unclaimed part is the quantified dose-response law and its size vs architecture effects. Lit-attacked below.
'Topology is lost at checkpoint-selection time, not training time' is a sharp, cheap, actionable reframing of the clDice line; every checkpoint is already logged in a normal run. Best of C03.
Dimensionless spacing/diameter crossover would upgrade nnU-Net-style heuristics into a law; heavy training grid is the cost. Native-anisotropy validation leg is non-negotiable.
Post-hoc fatigue forensics on public datasets is an original, label-free audit; quality-proxy indirectness is the weak joint, patched by small spot re-annotation.

'Domain gap is mostly signal-processing gap' is a useful decomposition, but low-level/semantic distances are confounded in the wild; the synthetic-perturbation leg does the real work and shrinks the claim.

Real-click-vs-simulator gap has landed for natural images (RClicks-style work); the clinician-specific corpus and method-reordering claim remain open and MICCAI-relevant. Small-N is survivable if traces are released.

SynthSeg already demonstrated contrast-agnostic segmentation via aggressive synthetic contrast randomization; physics-consistent inversion is an augmentation flavor, not a new question. Pathology-erasure caveat further narrows it.
Useful regime map for tiny-lesion pipelines; the implementation-asymmetry confound (own note) is the classic reviewer kill and hard to fully neutralize.
Seed-dependent bimodality + metric decoupling in the extreme-imbalance regime is a real phenomenon nobody has pinned down; the synthetic imbalance ladder is the right instrument.

Physics augmentation for MRI is established in reconstruction, and the decomposition's ceiling is set by simulation fidelity to proprietary pipelines (own risk note) - the conclusion is uninterpretable when closure fails.
Physically-motivated and probably right, but cross-operator data scarcity means a phantom study carries the claim - thin for a main venue, good MICCAI workshop-to-paper ladder.

'Which leaderboards have crossed their own noise floor' is a field-level service with teeth; the style-vs-anatomy error decomposition is what elevates it above known single-dataset inter-rater studies.
Prompt-space (not image-space) anatomical normalization is a neat inversion, and failure-as-anomaly-detector is a bonus claim; landmark-detector co-failure (own note) entangles exactly that bonus.
Site/scanner fingerprints are established in radiomics and site-invariance methods exist in federated medical imaging; the joint quantification is consolidation, not discovery.

Anti-conservative volume CIs from boundary-correlated errors is a precise, checkable, clinically consequential claim with a constructive fix; synthetic-lesion anchor kills the GT-uncertainty objection. Top-3 in batch A.
Outcome-anchored test of consensus erasing the correct minority expert is the most ethically loaded finding available in this cluster; data access is the wall. Protect as HRHR. Lit-attacked below.
